# KPI definitions

Every figure on the dashboard comes from one of these definitions. The SQL runs against `analytics_marts.appointments` (alias `a`) with the dashboard filters added as parameters.

## Appointments

Appointments in the date range that are still in the hospital system (removed ones excluded).

```sql
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_removed)
```

## Completed

Appointments marked done (a diagnosis was recorded).

```sql
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed')
```

## Upcoming

Not yet done, dated today or later.

```sql
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'scheduled')
```

## Not completed

Date has passed but the appointment was never marked done. This is the closest measure of no-shows the hospital data allows: it also includes visits that happened but were not documented.

```sql
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'unresolved')
```

## Removed (cancelled)

Appointments the pipeline saw on an earlier run that were later deleted. The hospital app deletes an appointment when a patient cancels or a doctor removes it, so only removals after the pipeline started running can be counted.

```sql
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_removed)
```

## Completion rate

Completed divided by past appointments (completed + not completed). Upcoming appointments are left out because their outcome is not known yet.

```sql
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'unresolved')), 0)
```

## Not-completed rate (no-show proxy)

Not completed divided by past appointments. Read as an upper bound on the no-show rate.

```sql
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'unresolved')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'unresolved')), 0)
```

## Removal rate

Removed divided by all appointments the pipeline has seen in the range, including removed ones.

```sql
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_removed)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
```

## Slot utilisation

Booked appointments divided by the one-hour slots doctors' working hours offered on the same days. Days before the pipeline's first run use today's working hours (marked as back-filled).

```sql
SUM(appointments)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(scheduled_slots), 0)  -- over analytics_marts.daily_department_operations
```

## Patients seen or booked

Distinct pseudonymous patients with an appointment in the range. Groups smaller than 5 are hidden in patient breakdowns.

```sql
COUNT(DISTINCT patient_sk) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_removed)
```

## Change in demand

Appointments in the range compared with the same number of days immediately before it.

```sql
(current_period - previous_period)::numeric / NULLIF(previous_period, 0)
```
